title: onobrychis crista-galli var. trilophocarpa
intro: Onobrychis crista-galli var. trilophocarpa, commonly known as a plant species within the legume family, is a type of sainfoin. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Onobrychis crista-galli var. trilophocarpa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
